settings.title: Messaging
settings.description: What Housetel writes to your guests by email and WhatsApp, and when.
settings.readOnly: You can see the settings but not change them (you need the templates permission).

sourceHint.system: This is the text Housetel ships. Saving creates your own version.
sourceHint.organization: Shared by every hotel of the organization.

templates.subject: Subject

templates.restoreTitle: Go back to the inherited text?

templates.newDescription: For messages you send by hand from the inbox or use in an automatic message.
templates.name: Name

templates.newVariantHint: This template has no text yet for this channel and language. Saving creates it.

templates.noCustom: No templates of your own yet.

rules.noChannels: Pick at least one channel so it's sent.

when.post_stay_one: {{count}} day after departure, to ask for feedback.
when.post_stay_other: {{count}} days after departure, to ask for feedback.

when.cancellation: When a confirmed booking is cancelled.
